findings.reason: This module implements a state machine that triggers only when a highly specific sequence of four 128-bit values is observed on the state input.
This signal is the trigger output that activates when a rare sequence of 128-bit state values is detected, enabling the Trojan payload.
This register tracks the first step of a rare 4-step sequence of 128-bit values required to activate the Trojan trigger.
This is the instance of the Trojan_Trigger module which monitors the AES state for a rare sequence of inputs to activate the payload.
This is the instance of the TSC module which leaks key bits via capacitance/power side-channel modulation when activated by the trigger.
